## Context / Problem
After S2b/S2c, runtime and factories agree, but users still see hand-maintained package help and the old two-family intercept behavior. Canonical generated artifacts may become authoritative only after the complete parser/route census is proven.

## Approach
Add `scripts/gen_cli_help.py` with write and `--check` modes.

- Enumerate canonical/compatibility/hidden routes from the immutable registry; resolve parser factories only in generation/check execution.
- Render with S2a's fixed `prog`, width, formatter, ordering, UTF-8 LF, and trailing-newline policy.
- Write one artifact per canonical help key; exact aliases reuse canonical bytes. Compatibility/hidden spellings render the same argument-definition helpers with approved alias `prog` and replacement epilog.
- Generate the grouped overview from route group/order/visibility plus parser summaries. Canonical visible commands appear once; aliases are annotated rather than duplicated; hidden routes are omitted.
- Fail `--check` on any missing/stale/stray artifact, unresolved factory, non-deterministic second render, registry/parser census mismatch, or generated package-data diff.
- Keep curated explanations/examples inside parser descriptions/epilogs or later editorial reference sections; no hand-authored usage line or option table may be concatenated after generation.

Cut top-level overview/help/unknown routing to the registry and committed artifacts. The lexical pre-scan handles global config-prefix token shape, command identity, `rebar help <command>`, and a first `--help`/`-h` token after the spelling. It must complete before RP-04 snapshot, config parsing/materialization, mount, handler/factory resolution, or optional imports. Free-text `--help` later in argv remains data/handler input as today.

Approved behavior changes: the 21 formerly intercept-only help forms now succeed safely; overview grouping changes; help output becomes deterministic parser-rendered text; and help artifact bodies are regenerated from the true post-S2b/S2c factory grammar, correcting hand-captured drift (only the capitalized Usage: prefix is preserved byte-for-byte). Unknown/help streams and exit codes, historical `jira-onboard`, hidden `bridge-status`, and unknown `purge-bridge` remain as specified.

## Out-of-directory consumers of the help surface (census + disposition)
The cutover changes package help data read by consumers OUTSIDE `src/rebar/_cli/help/`. Each is enumerated with a disposition:

- `scripts/gen_cli_reference.py` + its `docs/cli-reference.md` drift gate — reads `_help.known_subcommands()`/`subcommand_help()` and drift-gates `INTERCEPT_COMMANDS` against its OWN `ladder_intercepts()` (defined at `scripts/gen_cli_reference.py:305`, which parses `src/rebar/_cli/__init__.py` source — NOT a `rebar._cli.__init__` symbol). Disposition: KEPT WORKING — those `_help` reader signatures are unchanged (they now read GENERATED `help/*.txt`), so no generator-script code change; `docs/cli-reference.md` is REGENERATED via its `--check` gate as an approved doc delta.
- Tests pinning `known_subcommands()`/`overview()` shape or the intercept set — `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_help_overview_coverage.py` (`^  <sub>` shape, `_OVERVIEW_ALLOWLIST`), `test_schema_coverage.py`, `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_exit_codes_doc_conformance.py` + `_heldout.py` (`known_subcommands() | _INTERCEPTS`), `tests/interfaces/facades/test_cli_argparse.py`, `test_central_mount_gate_ad9f.py` (its pre-operation-boundary sentinels extend to the new help pre-scan). Disposition: UPDATED as approved deltas for new overview grouping/uniqueness and retired intercept forms. `tests/unit/test_gen_cli_reference.py` re-runs, updated only where re-sourcing changes a value.
- Literal `Usage: rebar <cmd>` PREFIX consumers — `tests/interfaces/facades/test_cli.py` (81/91/106/112/122), `scripts/probe_rebar.py:585`, `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_signature.py`. Disposition: KEPT VALID by the ONE byte-parity invariant preserved — the CAPITALIZED `Usage:`. Argparse/`RebarHelpFormatter` render lowercase `usage:`, so `gen_cli_help.py` MUST render through a formatter emitting `Usage: ` capitalized (a lowercase `usage:` in any artifact is a `--check` failure). Generation-only; runtime `--help` serves the committed txt.
- subcommand_help() BODY-content consumers (not the prefix) — `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_force_unification_blusterous.py:131` (selects `transition`'s `--reason` line), `tests/unit/test_bridge_projects_surfaces_heldout.py:124` (asserts `bridge` help has `projects`). Disposition: KEPT VALID because the enriched `transition`/`bridge` factories genuinely render those same option/subparser lines; verified by exact-artifact-bytes assertions.
- Help artifact BODIES (below the `Usage:` line) — APPROVED REGENERATION DELTA, not byte-exact with today's committed text (that hand-captured drift is what this task eliminates). Proof they must be corrected to the factory's real grammar: `help/show.txt` shows `[--output llm] [--no-pull]` but `build_show()` (`_parsers/core/reads.py`) has `--output {json,llm}`, `--include-scratch`/`--include-provenance`, and NO `--no-pull`; `help/list.txt` carries per-option help + `--no-pull` absent from `build_list()`; `help/overview.txt` carries curated one-liners absent from factory summaries. The factory (true runtime grammar) wins; `--check` pins the regenerated bytes.
- Factory enrichment (home for curated prose) — core factories carry ZERO argument `help=` text/`description`, so the curated per-option/per-subcommand text now in the artifacts has no render home. This task ENRICHES `src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/core/` and `_parsers/advanced/` with per-argument `help=`, `description`/`epilog`, and `argparse.SUPPRESS` for hidden args — so those explanations live inside the parser and the generator renders them (no hand-authored table concatenated after generation).

## Compatibility and Rollback
The existing execution ladder remains active. Commit generator, artifacts, route-help lookup, and subprocess tests together. Reverting this task restores the old help family without changing runtime grammar or stored data.

## Testing
Use generator unit tests and real CLI subprocess tests in a fresh attachable checkout. Sentinels raise if help/unknown paths compose an operation snapshot, read config, mount/create a store, resolve a parser/handler, or import heavy optional modules. Assert exact artifact bytes, streams, exit codes, overview uniqueness/grouping, every alias class, malformed global syntax, free-text negative control, and a normal execution control that still crosses operation/mount boundaries.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `scripts/gen_cli_help.py --check` proves every registered help artifact and overview are deterministic, parser-derived, complete, and free of stale/stray resources.
- [ ] Every visible canonical command appears once in the grouped overview; exact aliases reuse bytes and compatibility/hidden/retired spellings follow the approved rules.
- [ ] Both top-level help forms return exact committed generated bytes before operation/config/store/parser/handler/optional-import boundaries.
- [ ] Free-text later `--help`, malformed global syntax, unknown commands, streams, and exit codes match the explicit compatibility contract.
- [ ] A normal execution negative control still reaches RP-04 operation composition and established mount/init behavior through the old execution ladder.
- [ ] No hand-maintained usage or option table remains in package help.
